title: Settings
closeFiltersLabel: Close the filter panel after applying
closeFiltersDesc: After clicking "Apply filters" the filter panel will close automatically instead of staying open.
elevationDesc: Used by the "Terrain and range analysis" tool. Change it only if you actually need to.
elevationSefinekDesc: GEDTM30 terrain model (~30 m, fusion of ICESat-2/GEDI/Copernicus/ALOS) with bilinear interpolation - currently the most accurate source, but it's beta.
elevationOpenElevationDesc: SRTM data (~30-90 m). Free public API with no availability guarantee - can be overloaded or temporarily unreachable.
elevationOpenMeteoDesc: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (90 m). Stable and fast, but less precise in varied terrain.
